cues.text: Hello, London Police Department
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: Yes, I would like to report a robbery
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: Alright, just a minute while I pull up the form. OK, could you give me your first and last name?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: Anna Grieg.
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: Anna, Greg? G-R-E-G?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: No, Grieg. G-R-I-E-G.
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: Got it. Alright moving on: gender - female. Date of birth?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: 15th of March, 1980
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: Alright, thanks. Just a few more personal information questions and then we can address your claim.
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: Alright
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: What is the address?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: 4 Ellendale St. That’s E-L-L-E-N-D-A-L-E
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: Oh right, Ellendale Street. Yeah we’ve had a lot of break-ins in that area lately. And the postal code?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: W52AT
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: And are you a citizen of the UK?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: No
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: Okay, what type of citizenship do you have?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: Well, I lived in the United States for most of my life, but I am actually of Grenadian nationality.
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: Okay, so is that the country that issued your passport?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: Yes.
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: Alright.
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: And what is the crime you are reporting?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: I already said - a robbery!
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: Oh, right. Sorry, this is about the hundredth robbery report I’ve filled out today. Have you had any prior break-ins?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: Um, in the building or just my flat? The unit below mine got broken into last year.
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: No, just your flat.
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: Oh - then no. Not here.
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: Alright, let’s see here. Can you think of anything that was out of the ordinary around your building, or anyone who may have had reason to do this?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: No, it seemed like just a normal evening. I didn’t see anyone suspicious, and can’t think of anyone that would target me specifically.
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: How long has this been your place of residence?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: Hm, let me think. I moved in on February 1, and it’s October, so it’s been about 8 months already. Wow, time flies!
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: And that is just Ellendale, yeah?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: Yes. I have lived in the UK for just over one year.
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: I see. Can you give me the first and last name of all members of the household?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: Actually, I live alone.
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: OK - so no other occupants. And can you give me a brief account of what happened?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: I left to go to a dinner party at 6 p.m, and when I returned at 11 I found the place ransacked and a lot of my things gone.
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: Any sign of forced entry?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: Yes, the back door was wide open, and it looked like someone used a crowbar to force it open.
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: I see. And just to be clear, was the door locked when you left?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: Of course!
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: Hey, you would be surprised how many reports we get where people have failed to lock their doors. Now I need you to list any missing items valued above £200.
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: So far I’m missing my computer, my purse with my wallet in it, and the TV.
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: OK, Let’s start with the computer. What is the estimated value?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: And what is the serial number?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: Thank you, and a visual description?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: It is a black 13-inch Pemdas Cloudbook. There is an Oxford sticker on the lid.
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: OK, and could you give a description of the purse?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: Sure. It’s a Claude Frieda shoulder bag and the material is silver-colored cloth.
cues.speaker: Anna

cues.text: Price?
cues.speaker: Police

cues.text: Okay. That concludes my report. I’ll submit it and we’ll let you know of any developments.
cues.speaker: Police
